basics.name: Nagarjuna Reddy Kamireddy
basics.label: Lead AI Architect | AI Solutions Architect | GenAI Lead (Agentic AI & RAG) | Corporate AI Trainer
basics.summary: Lead AI Architect with 22 years in enterprise data and AI (aliases: Nagarjuna Kamireddy, Nagarjuna K, Nagarjun Reddy Kamireddi): a decade of production ML and GenAI (John Deere, Persistent Systems, Vertiv, Soham Global) built on 12 years embedded at client sites as an SAP BW / BPC / HANA Lead Consultant across the UK, Malaysia, Singapore, the US, and India. Most recently owned architecture, AWS Terraform platform, and delivery for a 12+ member team across 23+ AI initiatives at John Deere — 750K+ automated requests and 42K+ hours saved in FY26. Currently in Dubai, UAE and available immediately globally.

work.name: John Deere
work.position: AI Architect & Technical Lead (Official Title: Senior Data Scientist)
work.summary: Owned architecture, AWS platform, and delivery for 23+ AI initiatives across a 12+ member team in Customer & Product Support (750K+ automated requests, 42K+ hours saved in FY26).
highlights: Built StoneAge multi-model agentic writing copilot (LangGraph, OpenSearch hybrid search, GPT-5/GPT-4o/Gemini routing, React, FastAPI, Okta).
Rescued a ~30%-accurate GenAI product to ~70% accuracy via GPT-4o Vision diagram extraction, product-family routing, and deterministic rule checks (46 active users).
Designed a 6-agent authoring system backed by a Neo4j knowledge graph and built AIFlow (255 CI quality checks + zero-latency live drift/cost telemetry).
Repaired ~171K broken links (~8,600 hrs saved), generated ~110K standards-compliant documents (100% Large Tractor adoption), and automated ~25% of support tickets (~83% accuracy).
Built self-service Terraform + GitHub Actions AWS platform; served on AI Governance Council (NIST AI RMF / EU AI Act); upskilled 300+ employees.
